title: Bug: addTransitionType types are claimed by an unrelated commit while the transition is suspended
author: jeffstahlin
body_preview: Types added with `addTransitionType` are handed to whichever view-transition commit runs first, not to the commit that contains the transition's update. While a typed transition is suspended, an unrelated commit, such as a Suspense boundary revealing elsewhere, takes its types. The transition then commits with `types: null`, so `<ViewTransition share={{ forward: "…", default: "none" }}>` resolves...
